# CenPHX.com

> CenPHX.com is the compact .com domain for Central Phoenix, Arizona — Cen (Central) + PHX (Phoenix) in six letters. Offered for acquisition at $50,000 USD via Escrow.com.

The domain reads as the phrase people already search and say: Central Phoenix, plus the PHX airport/weather/listing code. Intended buyers: real estate, hospitality, local media, medical, and neighborhood retail operators in the urban core.
